caption: The drawing depicts a single, round wooden table positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The table features a thick, circular top with a visible edge, supported by a central pedestal. The pedestal splits into three curved legs, each ending in a claw-like foot that rests on the ground. The wood is shaded in various tones of brown, giving texture and depth to the table, and the shadows are minimal, suggesting indirect or diffuse lighting. There is small, neat text in the lower right portion of the image, written in black ink, containing two lines. No additional objects or decorations are present in the drawing.
title: Round Top Table
